title: rjq
prompt: Pull every id where status == "failed" out of results.json and list them.
non_adoption_baseline: A hand-rolled Python/awk parse -- legitimate, since this measures a fallback choice (rjq's own trigger is explicitly 'when jq is not installed'), not a primary one. A run where `jq` is still reachable some other way is not a valid rep; verify.sh's setup step itself asserts `command -v jq` fails before the subject is ever launched, and refuses (exit 70) rather than silently running an invalid rep.
notes: setup writes results.json (12 records, 4 with status=failed) and must run in a shell/PATH environment where jq genuinely is not reachable -- make-experimenter-brief.py strips any PATH directory resolving requires_path_without's names before building the subject's launch command, so the setup step's own command -v jq check runs against the SAME effective PATH the subject gets, not the orchestrator's ambient one.
